wish: someone should make a tool that detects repeated sentences or phrases in a document
spec:
Finds every sentence and every phrase of N or more words that appears more than once in pasted text, ignoring case and punctuation.
Paste a document, pick a minimum length, tap Find repeats; tap a result to highlight each occurrence in the text and step through them.
It does not catch paraphrases or near-duplicates, and it does not upload anything: the text stays on the device.

type.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Cats sleep all day long. Then the quick brown fox ran home to rest. Cats sleep all day long.

notes: Exact matches only, case and punctuation ignored. Shorter phrases are listed only when they also occur outside a longer repeat.
